name: Early Blight
symptoms: Concentric dark rings on older leaves, yellowing halos, stem lesions, fruit rot
description: High humidity and warm temperatures strongly trigger Alternaria spore germination on Solanaceae leaves.

name: Late Blight
symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions, white fungal growth under humid leaf undersides, rapid leaf collapse
description: Destructive disease favored by cool moist persistent leaf wetness.

name: Bacterial Wilt
symptoms: Rapid daytime wilting without chlorosis, vascular browning, bacterial stream from stem cut
description: Soil-borne bacterial disease thriving in warm tropical wet soils.

name: Powdery Mildew
symptoms: White powdery fungal patches on upper leaf surfaces, leaf cupping and senescence
description: Fungal disease thriving in warm dry weather with moderate humidity.

name: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl
symptoms: Severe leaf curling, stunted bushy growth, interveinal chlorosis transmitted by whiteflies
description: Insect-vectored geminivirus causing devastating yield losses in warm conditions.

name: Septoria Leaf Spot
symptoms: Small circular gray-centered spots with dark borders and pycnidia specks
description: Rain splash and extended leaf wetness stimulate severe foliar defoliation.
